Controlled follow-up timeline run with only its private Xvfb terminated captured _XIOError followed by std::system_error (Invalid argument) during exit; this demonstrates an abnormal display-loss cleanup failure, not the original bad_alloc allocation.

A second controlled display-loss run captured _XIOError and stalled until its owned 120-second timeout (124); no bad_alloc caught. Owned inferior was confirmed exited. These failed injected runs are not clean GUI passes.

piano_chord_followup.status: Fixed and reviewed; final Linux sanitizer units and Mac/Windows native checks passed.
piano_chord_followup.cause: Two different defects: the scenario fence observed raw events before the keyboard six-frame sounding-note release, and step recording decremented accepted held notes for rejected note-offs regardless of source identity.
